name: sudo-approvals
description: Review privileged command requests in KiroCrew or arm a bounded auto-approval window.
author: Sudo Approvals contributors
highlights: Shows the exact command and working directory before a manual approval
Deploys the kiro-sudo command wrapper to your PATH on enable, so the approval gate is active (not just a backend listening)
Supports server-enforced 5 minute, 15 minute, 30 minute, 1 hour, and 2 hour auto-approval windows
Uses a generic configurable FIFO protocol that can be integrated with any local command wrapper
Verifies every gateway proxy request with a per-installation HMAC secret
